description: Productize the recommended private-access path so Homebase can plan, execute, verify, and repair Tailscale Serve publishing instead of relying on manual operator commands.

timing.plannedEarliestExecution: After Admin Auth and the control-plane IA split
timing.gatingCondition: Requires admin-protected execution, captured real tailscale CLI fixtures, and a locked merge/ownership policy for existing Tailscale Serve config. Authentication via `tailscale up` may remain manual.

principles: Sovereign Home should feel like a named service, not a host with ports
Never silently overwrite unrelated Tailscale Serve config
Verify both local nginx upstream and Tailscale Serve result
Keep public internet exposure out of the default path

techStack.runtime: tailscale CLI, nginx local HTTPS upstream, systemd job runner
techStack.storage: SQLite jobs plus optional publishing state/config record
techStack.testing: Planner unit tests + manual VM tailnet verification

userStories.title: Detect Tailscale identity and publishing readiness
acceptanceCriteria: Network/setup page shows Tailscale installed/daemon/authenticated status
Homebase identifies current node name and tailnet/MagicDNS hostname when available
Current `tailscale serve get-config --all` is visible or summarized
UI distinguishes not installed, not authenticated, authenticated but unpublished, and published states
userStories.testStrategy: Unit tests around parser/status mapping plus VM check with authenticated and unauthenticated states

userStories.title: Plan and execute prescribed Serve topology
acceptanceCriteria: Planner previews Homebase lane: tcp:3080 -> http://127.0.0.1:3080
Planner previews app lane: tcp:443 -> https+insecure://localhost:443
Execution is admin-unlock protected and guarded by EXECUTE
Existing non-Homebase Serve config is not silently destroyed
userStories.testStrategy: Planner tests for generated commands and manual VM execution against tailnet

userStories.title: Verify and repair service publishing
acceptanceCriteria: Verification checks local nginx 443 listener before publishing
Verification checks Serve config contains expected tcp:3080 and tcp:443 endpoints
Hostname/domain setting changes surface a repair prompt if publishing is stale
UI provides final copyable Homebase and app base URLs
userStories.testStrategy: Manual VM verification plus fixture tests for stale/missing Serve config parsing

high: Incorrect Serve config changes could disrupt a user's existing tailnet services
medium: Tailscale CLI output/config shape may vary by version
Authentication still requires an operator-owned action unless OAuth/device flow is designed
low: The target topology has already been manually validated in VM testing

preFlightChecklist: Capture real `tailscale status --json` and `tailscale serve get-config --all` examples
Lock policy for existing Serve config: manage only Home Base-owned endpoints and refuse silent overwrite of unrelated Serve config
Define whether Homebase stores a managed-service marker or derives state entirely from Serve config
Confirm Network page scaffold from Feature-3a is ready for publishing UI
